verdict.rationale: Multi-currency balances are a fair question for a business banking platform like Relay, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows up to 20 checking accounts for splitting funds and the ability to send and receive international wires. Nothing documents holding or managing balances in currencies other than one. International wires and multiple sub-accounts are adjacent features, not multi-currency balance holding.

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account
